responsibility: This source file implements GCC’s in-process plugin framework: loading plugins named on the command line, tracking their arguments and metadata, registering and invoking callbacks for compiler events, allocating dynamic event IDs, and reporting active plugin state. It owns the tables of plugin_name_args records, event-name mappings, and callback lists, provides help/version dumping and finalization logic, performs compatibility checks and GPL symbol checks when plugins are loaded, and exposes the runtime used by the rest of GCC to notify plugins at parsing, pass-manager, GGC, and finish events.
same_name_distinction: Contains the runtime machinery for GCC plugins—loading modules, tracking plugin instances and arguments, mapping event names to IDs, registering/invoking callbacks, and reporting active plugins—whereas gcc/plugin.def is just the hard-coded event list and gcc/plugin.h is the API/header surface built around it.
